name: New Relic Free
free_limit: New Relic Free: 100 GB data ingest/month, one full-platform user, unlimited basic users and 500 synthetic monitoring checks
watch_out: No credit card needed for the perpetual Free edition. Default data retention is at least 8 days, varying by data type; data ingest stops when Free exceeds its monthly 100 GB allowance until next month or upgrade. Additional full-platform seats and ingest beyond 100 GB on paid editions are billable.
